title: Rule 506 interests are federal covered securities
rule: Securities sold under the SEC's rules made under Section 4(a)(2), which is Rule 506, are covered securities, so states cannot require their registration. States may still require a copy of the Form D, a consent to service of process and a fee, for notice purposes, and they keep their anti-fraud authority. A sale relying on Section 4(a)(2) alone gets no such preemption, so state exemption rules apply in full.

sources.title: 15 U.S.C. 77r, Exemption from State regulation of securities offerings
